# Shalom Park — Instagram keyword rules

*Generated from `keywords.csv` by `tools/build-keywords.js`. **Do not edit this file** — edit the CSV and rebuild. 27 rules, 356 trigger phrases.*

> **How to read this.** A buyer comments or DMs. If their words hit a trigger, they get exactly the text in "What the buyer is sent" — no AI involved, no chance of a wrong number. Anything that hits nothing goes to the Concierge brain instead.

## Safety class — always a human, never a canned fact

These beat every commercial rule when both match. A buyer asking about returns on a specific unit gets a person, not a price.

## Notes on each rule

| Rule | Grounded in | Note |
|---|---|---|
| SP-ESC-ROI | must_not_say[0] · must_not_say[1] | NEVER give a figure. Zero facts by design. Narrowed 2026-09-15: general investment interest now goes to SP-INVEST, which answers with warranted facts. This rule keeps the projection asks - and still outranks SP-INVEST when both match. |
| SP-ESC-REFUND | payment.refund_policy.summary | Verbatim per kb assistant_handling. Never soften or omit the 25% or the resale condition. |
| SP-ESC-PAYTO | payment.account_name · payment.account_number_policy | States the account NAME (warranted) and never a number. Highest-trust moment in the whole flow. |
| SP-ESC-DISC | pricing_terms.negotiable · payment.initial_deposit · payment.plan_durations | Negotiability is warranted. No discount authority exists. |
| SP-ESC-LEGAL | documentation.litigation_acquisition_or_dispute · documentation.title_status | Conversational statement of a warranted fact is permitted. Documents not yet sighted by Propel - Gate 2. |
| SP-ESC-COMPLETE | development.overall_stage_percent · escalate_always[0] | estimated_completion_date is null in the KB. Escalation is the only correct answer. |
| SP-ESC-FEES | pricing_terms.included_in_price · pricing_terms.excluded_from_price · pricing_terms.excluded_amounts_supplied | Excluded ITEMS are warranted. Excluded AMOUNTS are not supplied - never estimate them. |
| SP-ESC-AGENT | escalate_always[9] | Commercial terms are never the assistants business. |
| SP-ESC-MORTGAGE | payment.initial_deposit · payment.plan_durations | No mortgage or financing arrangement exists anywhere in the facts sheet. |
